title: Challenge Template: Algorithmic Quantum Challenge
storyScenario: A quantum communication station needs to initialize a register in an entangled state to transmit encrypted keys.
description: Construct a quantum circuit that prepares the state |ψ⟩ from ground state |00⟩ under strict gate constraints.
targetGoal: Prepare state |ψ⟩ = (|00⟩ + |11⟩)/√2 with 50% probability on |00⟩ and 50% on |11⟩.

starterCode.qiskit:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

def build_circuit():
    qc = QuantumCircuit(2)
    # Your solution here
    qc.h(0)
    qc.cx(0, 1)
    return qc
starterCode.cirq:
import cirq

q = cirq.LineQubit.range(2)
circuit = cirq.Circuit(
    cirq.H(q[0]),
    cirq.CNOT(q[0], q[1])
)

testCases.name: Hidden Test: Zero Leakage into |01⟩ and |10⟩
Hidden Test: Relative Phase Alignment
testCases.assertion: Re(α) > 0 and Re(β) > 0 with zero imaginary phase

editorial.mathematicalProof: Applying H to qubit 0 produces (|0⟩+|1⟩)/√2 ⊗ |0⟩ = (|00⟩+|10⟩)/√2. The subsequent CNOT conditionally flips qubit 1, producing (|00⟩+|11⟩)/√2 with Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen (EPR) entanglement.
editorial.algorithmicAnalysis: The circuit creates maximum 2-qubit entanglement in O(1) circuit depth and requires only 2 elementary unitary gates.
editorial.complexity: Time Complexity: O(1) gate time. Space Complexity: O(1) 2 qubits.

hints: Step 1: Put the control qubit into equal superposition using a Hadamard (H) gate.
Step 2: Entangle the target qubit using a CNOT gate with control on Q0 and target on Q1.
Step 3: Verify that the relative phase is positive to match |Φ⁺⟩ rather than |Φ⁻⟩.
